decision.limitation: One alternating cold pair per local object, with provisioned support. Discovery, recognition, hint persistence, original acquisition and historical audits are additional. Isolated exclusions regress; no end-to-end gain is established.
decision.next_target: Test a selective live local-contradiction gate: opposite units, then units plus original binary clauses, then supported binary guards. Check only active short guards, find a contradiction by SCC and compile its two paths. Keep source support containment and native recomposition; compare whole-query cost and completion against ordinary and guided policies, including misses and cold replay.
decision.result: Source-bound guard consequences compose into 61 native local refutations. Twenty need binary guards; three roots were absent after the preceding shared query budget. Both acquisition controls complete with individual budgets.
decision.scope: Wider guards, automatic origin discovery, general transport, fresh unlabelled evaluation and uniformly efficient arbitrary-CNF closure remain open. Guard graph components need not be independent source components.
decision.secondary_target: Share repeated exact core bodies in the separate hint bank; 6100 hints reference 616 cores. No new storage scheme or memory reduction is implemented here.
decision.status: offline diagnostic; no default change or new completed whole query

limitations: All 648 saved ordinary-probe contexts from eight exposed edits are inspected. Earlier origin acquisition and passive context capture are additional costs; no later repeats or cumulative history seed discovery or compilation.

Each compatible source template is transported under the fixed context only if all surviving support clauses occur in the actual local CNF. Its negated remaining guard is checked by the existing exact-core RUP checker.

All guard widths are recorded. Reachability closes only the width-at-most-two fragment, compared with original binary clauses, guard clauses alone and their union. The learned graph is a necessary condition, not an exact replacement of the whole CNF.

Candidates are forced literals absent from original binary closure and direct unit guards. Selected witnesses must use a new binary guard clause; choose chronological contexts, mixed witnesses first, then literal order, at most two per context and sixteen per target.

Each selected candidate has one cold native acquisition and one cold proof-compilation pair with empty stores. Transport uses provisioned templates; matching, preparation and persistence are separately charged, not omitted from the study. One pair is diagnostic, not a reliable speedup estimate.

Path compilation uses saved unit leaves and existing native split nodes, without SAT search. Conservative leaf misses use the existing small-support materializer, with its propagation charged. Every native publication is checked.

All accepted RUP hints and both arms' retained native rows are preserved separately. Warm and cold replay include full checks. Graph components need not be independent source components; support overlaps and source components are recorded.

Limits bound selected certificates and path length only, not total candidate discovery, normalization, RUP checking, graph memory or the lifetime proof archive. No live policy, new whole-input performance result or unrestricted polynomial SAT bound.
One cold pair per local CNF, with empty native stores and provisioned checked guard supports. Earlier discovery/transport and all persistence costs are additional.
Compare original binary plus unit guards with the full width-two consequence fragment. A guard-only contradiction need not require a binary guard.
Compile both polarities of the smallest contradictory variable, then use the existing native split rule. This is a local CNF refutation, not an automatic verdict on its originating whole query.

Mixed/new candidate counts in raw records are path-witness differences. On inconsistent graphs they are not new logical consequences; use the separate satisfiable_combined_graphs census for non-vacuous backbone comparisons.

The preserved six-table cumulative native bank and separate exact-core RUP hint bank have different roles. The latter is not a source verdict; source exclusions and local closures require their compiled native certificates.
